description: This file provides utility methods for file operations, such as reading the entire file content into a String or reading a file line by line into a List. It includes methods to check file existence and handles I/O exceptions.

classes.name: FileUtils
classes.description: A utility class offering static methods for reading files fully or line by line, with file existence checks.

methods.name: readFile
methods.description: Reads the entire contents of a specified file into a single String.

methods.name: readFileToList
methods.description: Reads the specified file line by line into a List of Strings.
